headless.note: Build/runtime surface used by UR-Recomp is command-line or libretro and does not require a desktop session.

purpose: Independent Mednafen/bsnes-derived SNES libretro oracle patched narrowly for correct SAVE_RAM exposure and single-owner framebuffer teardown. Build disables glibc fortify wrappers to avoid a modern-glibc collision with the bundled historical nall strlcpy/strlcat.
